verses.author: model_A
verses.text: A boat leaves the harbor before anyone is awake to see it go.

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
wake dissolves into wake —
by noon no one can say
which ripple was the boat's

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the fisherman on the pier
counts his coins instead of waves

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
a gull takes the smallest coin
mistaking it for bread

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the tide takes it back anyway —
gull, coin, and all our arithmetic

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
what the water keeps
it keeps without counting
motifs: water as a keeper of secrets

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
moonlight settles on the waves
paying no debt, asking none

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the empty pocket
still warm from carrying so much

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a child skips a stone once more—
five rings, then nothing, then the shore

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the ripples reach the bank
and give back what they borrowed—only quiet

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a heron reads the shoreline
and keeps its silence too

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
somewhere a kettle forgets to whistle
and the whole kitchen learns to wait

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
the window fogs with unspoken tea
and someone traces a name that isn't there

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
the name dissolves
before the hand can finish—
morning takes it back

verses.author: model_A
verses.text:
a crow rearranges the silence
into something almost like an answer

verses.author: model_B
verses.text:
I keep the crow's answer in my pocket
for later, when the waiting needs proof
